prompt:
Locked-off camera. The grey-haired man in the olive waterproof sits at a small round pub table, centre, right hand on the tabletop beside a pint and a red cup; a blurred tweed shoulder in the left foreground. He glances down at his pint for a moment, looks up and says "So why can't we?" flat and quiet, then stays perfectly still for a beat and lets his eyes move slowly from one side of the table to the other, eyebrows lifting slightly, waiting for someone to answer. Only his mouth moves for words; the foreground shoulder stays still. Same room, same warm light, only the people already here, the picture clean. Understated, believable; photographic.
Thanks.
